rules.rationale: Every surviving addition or removal from this A13 patch is present in the final Android 16 device component, including payload bytes where the evidence is an exact file match.
rules.necessity: Required when the per-entry file list is an active product input; removed intermediate code remains absent exactly as at the final A13 head.
rules.performance: No extra promotion work beyond the corresponding static payload, build metadata or on-demand helper recorded by the entry.
rules.security: The rule proves final content equivalence only; privileged binaries and native-bridge data remain subject to their component-level provenance and runtime gates.
validation_evidence: Final A13 and Android 16 file additions/removals were compared by normalized text or exact SHA-256 payload identity.

decisions.rationale: A13 avoided the HIDL dumpstate 1.1 crash by selecting 1.0. Android 16 no longer uses that HIDL declaration and packages android.hardware.dumpstate-service.example through its AIDL VINTF fragment.
decisions.necessity: The developer-options dumpstate path is required, but replaying an obsolete HIDL version is not.
decisions.performance: One standard AIDL service, with no additional polling.
decisions.security: Uses the current platform dumpstate interface instead of weakening the Android 16 manifest level.
validation_evidence: All 32 adapted HAL/service targets, including dumpstate, completed their dependency build; runtime developer-options regression remains pending.

decisions.rationale: The exact NDK translation payload is retained under libndk_baklava64, libnb still selects it per app, and Android 16 mounts the selected arm64 libraries before dropping app privileges. Houdini 16 remains the alternate backend.
decisions.necessity: Required for per-app ARM64 translation selection.
decisions.performance: Backend selection is per translated process; bind mounts occur once in the app namespace.
decisions.security: Translation payload is immutable product data; mount scope is limited to the selected app namespace.
validation_evidence: Payload files are exact; libnb, Houdini and app_process builds passed; translated-app runtime remains pending.

decisions.rationale: The A13 prebuilt-app discovery, presigned certificate handling, dex preoptimization and packaged JNI extraction remain in app/Android.mk, with the same product APK directory.
decisions.necessity: Required to package BlueStacks system applications and their architecture-specific native libraries.
decisions.performance: Build-time APK inspection and dex preoptimization; no new runtime loop.
decisions.security: All APKs remain PRESIGNED inputs, so signing provenance must be validated externally.
validation_evidence: Current app makefile and packaged APK inventory reviewed against A13.

decisions.rationale: ClearKey uses the Android 16 AIDL service. The retained Widevine 1.3 service owns manifest_android.hardware.drm@1.3-service.widevine.xml, which declares both Widevine factories, and the required FCM bridge is already present. No board-level duplicate is needed.
decisions.necessity: Required for Widevine and ClearKey DRM registration.
decisions.performance: VINTF metadata adds no steady-state work; service cost is unchanged.
decisions.security: The restricted Widevine binary remains provenance-gated and the legacy HIDL bridge is explicit technical debt.
validation_evidence: The frozen Android-16 build installs the Widevine service and generated module-owned fragment with both @1.3 factory fqnames. Source Android.bp binds that fragment through vintf_fragments; runtime playback validation remains pending.

decisions.rationale: The apksigner script and jar are exact A13 payloads. The private market keystore is intentionally excluded and must be injected from the external secret store.
decisions.necessity: Signer tooling is required; committing a reusable private key is not.
decisions.performance: On-demand signing tool only.
decisions.security: Removes the tracked private key and requires rotation/external provisioning.
validation_evidence: Script and jar final-file evidence is complete; keystore absence is asserted by the target commit.

decisions.rationale: xmllint remains a product package, backed by the current Android 16 libxml2 Soong module rather than the obsolete A13 Make-only definition.
decisions.necessity: Required by proper_shutdown guest data recovery.
decisions.performance: No cost unless recovery invokes the command.
decisions.security: Uses the maintained platform XML parser and does not add a privileged daemon.
validation_evidence: xmllint built and is present in the product package list.

decisions.rationale: The A13 relative kernel source path is retained as kernel-a16, the explicit Android 16 repository name, instead of the historical host-absolute path.
decisions.necessity: Required for reproducible in-tree kernel builds.
decisions.performance: Build-path metadata only.
decisions.security: Eliminates dependence on an uncontrolled host-absolute source directory.
validation_evidence: Current kernel task points only to kernel-a16 and earlier SquashFS kernel builds passed.

decisions.rationale: The consolidated libnb dispatcher, zygote guard, package comparison, callback synchronization and backend selection are retained with Android 16 native-bridge callback fields.
decisions.necessity: Required for deterministic, thread-safe native-bridge selection.
decisions.performance: One backend decision per translated process; callback locking is outside translated instruction hot paths.
decisions.security: Backend libraries are selected from fixed product paths; native bridge remains a privileged compatibility boundary.
validation_evidence: libnb and Houdini 16 builds passed; nativebridge runtime regression remains pending.

decisions.rationale: memtrack.bst remains packaged and Android 16 supplies the binderized memtrack service through com.android.hardware.memtrack rather than the A13 HIDL manifest block.
decisions.necessity: Required for graphics memory accounting and the product legacy HAL.
decisions.performance: Uses the standard Android 16 service lifecycle.
decisions.security: Avoids declaring a stale HIDL contract while preserving the product implementation.
validation_evidence: memtrack package/service targets built; runtime registration remains pending.

decisions.rationale: Active x86 resources, ALSA state, IDC, fstab/init data, media profiles, overlays, networking and build tasks are retained without restoring qvirt or obsolete GSI/MGSI boards. The board migration omitted the Camera, OMX, RenderScript, Sensors, SoundTrigger and DRM declarations required by still-packaged legacy providers; the committed x86_64-only correction restores them. The canonical app-player build proves BUILD_EXTERNAL_BLUESTACKS_SENSORS selects both sensors.default architectures, so the A13 passthrough Sensors 1.0 contract remains active.
decisions.necessity: Required product resources are preserved without reintroducing the removed unified bst_x86_64 board.
decisions.performance: Static product assembly; no additional runtime control plane.
decisions.security: Keeps board ownership in the standard Android x86_64 product and avoids inactive arm/GSI surface.
validation_evidence: Active resource files remain exact or complete. App-player output installs sensors.default and android.hardware.sensors@1.0-impl for both architectures. Commit 773ab33851c67d54c6f9b6912f23baf208d8c11b passes XML parsing, check-vintf-all, and generated vendor/APEX manifest uniqueness with zero duplicate instances; complete image and clean-Data runtime validation remain pending.

decisions.rationale: GNSS is correctly delivered by com.android.hardware.gnss with an APEX-owned AIDL fragment. ConfigStore 1.1 remains a standalone HIDL service with no fragment, so the committed x86_64 declaration and level-8 bridge restore its contract.
decisions.necessity: Required for location and legacy graphics configuration contracts.
decisions.performance: Standard service/APEX startup only.
decisions.security: Uses platform-owned manifests and avoids duplicate HAL declarations.
validation_evidence: GNSS APEX fragment ownership was verified in source. ConfigStore package presence alone was insufficient; commit 773ab33851c67d54c6f9b6912f23baf208d8c11b passes check-vintf-all and generated-manifest uniqueness, while runtime registration remains pending.

decisions.rationale: The A13 libnb dispatcher, allow/deny lists and package configuration are retained while the supplied Houdini 16 version-8 payload replaces Houdini 13.
decisions.necessity: Required for ARM64 application translation on Android 16.
decisions.performance: Native translation overhead is limited to ARM64 apps selected for this backend.
decisions.security: The proprietary payload is ignored from Git and must be provisioned from the authorized external package.
validation_evidence: libnb, houdini64, policy and ramdisk targets built; translated-app launch remains pending.

decisions.rationale: This duplicate/follow-up authority change reaches the same final NDK translation payload and per-app libnb selection as 0f405e00; both source SHAs map to the retained final implementation.
decisions.necessity: Required as part of the final NDK translation history and payload identity.
decisions.performance: No duplicate runtime path is introduced.
decisions.security: Uses the same immutable payload and app-namespace mount boundary.
validation_evidence: All translation payload files are exact after the Tiramisu-to-Baklava path rewrite.

decisions.rationale: The final A13 common-device manifest removes Gatekeeper 1.0. Android 16 preserves that removal: the selected product contains gatekeeperd client/framework code but no Gatekeeper provider binary or device-manifest entry, and app-player LockSettings explicitly handles the provider as unavailable. The commented A13 Wi-Fi Supplicant example removed in the same hunk is replaced by the selected AIDL version 5 service and its module-owned fragment.
decisions.necessity: Required to avoid registering the unsupported guest Gatekeeper HAL.
decisions.performance: Removes service startup.
decisions.security: Removes hardware-backed credential service capability; framework fallback behavior must be regression-tested.
validation_evidence: A13 final HEAD 48364e74 excludes Gatekeeper after source commit 7fd69d7. Android-16 installed-files contains gatekeeperd and client libraries but no Gatekeeper provider, while generated output contains the AIDL Wi-Fi Supplicant version 5 fragment. Lock/settings runtime regression remains pending.

decisions.rationale: lights.bst and the HIDL 2.0 wrapper remain packaged, but the Android 16 service has init metadata only and no VINTF fragment. The committed x86_64 declaration and level-8 bridge restore the retained endpoint.
decisions.necessity: Required for guest backlight and light-state handling.
decisions.performance: No extra lookup beyond normal HAL startup.
decisions.security: Avoids conflicting duplicate VINTF ownership.
validation_evidence: Source readback disproved service-owned VINTF. The old runtime recorded 673 rejected registrations; commit 773ab33851c67d54c6f9b6912f23baf208d8c11b passes check-vintf-all and generated-manifest uniqueness, while current-image light validation remains pending.

decisions.rationale: This duplicate apksigner payload commit maps to the same exact script/jar and externally provisioned keystore policy as 38931480.
decisions.necessity: Signer tooling remains required; duplicated private-key history is not replayed.
decisions.performance: On-demand signing only.
decisions.security: No private signing key is stored in the Android 16 tree.
validation_evidence: Final apksigner script/jar identity and keystore exclusion reviewed.

decisions.rationale: camera.bst replaces camera.x86 in the final Android 16 product package list.
decisions.necessity: Required for the BlueStacks camera HAL.
decisions.performance: Module selection only.
decisions.security: No extra camera provider is exposed beyond the selected product HAL.
validation_evidence: Package list and camera.bst component build history reviewed; camera runtime remains pending.

decisions.rationale: The obsolete broad common DRM declaration remains removed and ClearKey uses AIDL. Generated output proves Widevine 1.3 owns its exact module fragment, while the retained HIDL 1.0 default service has no fragment. The x86_64 correction therefore declares only the default 1.0 factories.
decisions.necessity: Required for stable DRM factory registration.
decisions.performance: No additional service beyond the selected DRM implementations.
decisions.security: Avoids broad or mismatched interface claims.
validation_evidence: Installed-files and generated VINTF output prove the default 1.0 service lacked a fragment and Widevine 1.3 owns one. Commit 773ab33851c67d54c6f9b6912f23baf208d8c11b passes check-vintf-all and generated-manifest uniqueness; default-factory runtime registration and playback validation remain pending.

decisions.rationale: Device packaging uses fixed fstab.baklava and init.baklava paths, init.x86.rc mounts that fstab, and system/core supplies the x86 hardware fallback without requiring a Player ro.hardware boot argument.
decisions.necessity: Required because the current Player reports an unknown boot hardware value.
decisions.performance: Boot-only path selection.
decisions.security: Deterministic packaged paths replace host-controlled board suffix dependence.
validation_evidence: Baklava files were read back from ramdisk and init.rc verifier passed; clean-Data boot remains pending.

decisions.rationale: power.bst and its HIDL 1.0 wrapper remain packaged alongside the Android 16 AIDL example service. The AIDL fragment does not declare the retained HIDL endpoint, so the committed exact x86_64 declaration and level-8 bridge restore it.
decisions.necessity: Required for App Player power hints and compatibility behavior.
decisions.performance: Normal HAL/service startup only.
decisions.security: Avoids duplicate manifest ownership while retaining the product module.
validation_evidence: Source readback disproved HIDL service-owned VINTF. The old runtime recorded 671 rejected registrations; commit 773ab33851c67d54c6f9b6912f23baf208d8c11b passes check-vintf-all and generated-manifest uniqueness, while target runtime registration and power-hint regression remain pending.
